agent_note: Extremely aphoristic quote page: 24 of 45 are gnomic essayistic reflection, which is exactly the false-present contamination METHODOLOGY warns about. Six Persian-language quotes indicate a translated edition leaking onto the work page; all discarded as paratext. No quote passed the quotation-mark majority test, so there are zero dialogue quotes; marks are largely absent from this page and the three mixed quotes (q00936, q00955) were decided by word-count majority, which makes them the audit points. 15 event quotes, 11 past / 4 present. The split looks strand-based rather than noise: the present quotes are frame/scene narration (a plane sitting on a runway, David's occupation, a present-tense description of an artwork or storm) while the past quotes are character-interior and backstory material, suggesting a present-tense main line alongside retrospective character chapters. Recording dual as the honest read of the four options, but this is a SPLIT_REVIEW candidate and the present side rests on only 4 quotes, one of which (q00936) is a coin-flip.
